web_freshness.uf_melanoma: Crawled last week; current recruiting confirmed by today's master

reviews.criteria: Currently enrolling; newly confirmed untreated multicentric intermediate/large-cell B/T lymphoma, age >=1, weight >8 kg; excludes stage V, extranodal and small-cell disease; CHOP follows HIFU; 3-week anticancer and 2-week steroid washouts.
reviews.funding: HIFU/anesthesia and study samples/labs covered, $2,000 CHOP credit and up to $2,000 extra HIFU-adverse-event/CHOP support; initial diagnosis and unrelated care owner-paid.

reviews.criteria: Currently enrolling; resectable liver tumors, anesthesia/surgery candidate; H-FIRE followed by CT and resection 5–7 days later; unsafe systemic illness/coagulation and declining resection excluded.
reviews.funding: H-FIRE, post-HFIRE CT and rechecks covered; $2,000 surgical credit; remaining surgical/unrelated costs owner-paid.

reviews.criteria: Currently enrolling; confirmed nonmetastatic appendicular OSA, age >=1, weight >8 kg, suitable acoustic window; HIFU followed by amputation and carboplatin; 3-week chemotherapy and 2-week steroid washouts.
reviews.funding: HIFU and functional imaging covered; up to $2,600 toward amputation and free chemotherapy rechecks; initial staging, remaining surgery and carboplatin administration owner-paid.

reviews.criteria: Currently enrolling on current master and individual invitation; splenic HSA after splenectomy, treatment-naive for adjuvant care, doxorubicin eligible; pre-study staging 10–16 days and first chemotherapy 14–17 days after surgery.
reviews.funding: Owner pays six doses approximately $1,275 plus evaluation/surgery/histology/labs/imaging/chemotherapy; only vaccine injection-site reaction treatment up to $100 covered.
reviews.contact: Study Interest Form and required veterinary Oncology Referral Form; PI Rowan Milner.

reviews.criteria: Current master lists enrolling; malignant melanoma resectable or minimal, no other life-threatening disease; initial staging, four vaccine doses approximately four weeks apart, restaging and optional six-month booster.
reviews.funding: Vaccines, initial evaluation and subsequent visits owner-paid; booster extra. No free-treatment inference.
reviews.contact: UF Oncology (352)392-2235; study interest and veterinary referral forms.
